differences.before: The three principal manuscript results M01, M02 and M03, with their original domains and quantifier order. M01: one finite C>0 before every n>0 and compact convex Euclidean body K with nonempty interior; there exists a literal real special-linear matrix S with finite actual H0 Rayleigh infimum on interior(S K) and lambda_1(interior(S K))*volume(K)^(2/n)<=C*n. M02: one finite C>0 before every n>0 and origin-symmetric compact convex volume-one K with nonempty interior in maximal Gaussian measure position; its actual H0 Rayleigh infimum is at most C*n. M03: for each real P>=2 one finite C(P)>0 precedes every n>0, every even isotropic probability law nu satisfying the conventional compact-set IsLogConcaveMeasure condition, least Poincare constant at most P and finite actual Gaussian-relative Fisher information, and every origin-symmetric compact convex body D with nonempty interior supporting nu almost everywhere; lambda_1(interior D)<=C(P)*(n+sqrt(n*I(nu|gamma))). The log-concave density is derived from the law's original finite-information hypothesis; no density witness, covariance lower bound, ellipsoid-existence conclusion or desired spectral estimate is an additional premise. This new standalone combined package is awaiting its own final exact-source build, axiom reports, independent canonical interface review and ordinary Linux sandboxed Comparator --paranoid/all-six replay. Earlier exact source results have their own accepted certificates, but their verdicts are not asserted as acceptance of this newly assembled root.
